title: Automotive Relays EV-A RELAYS (DC contactors), catalog ASCTB418E 201904
method: Table values copied from the datasheet/product page text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). Distributor-hosted (Farnell) copy of the Panasonic catalog sheet; values cross-checked with the manufacturer part page https://industry.panasonic.com/kr/ko/products/control/relay/vehicle/number/aeva1251 (same numbers). The spec table has no electrical-life row at rated or partial load and no separate max switching voltage row; only switch-off life (1,800 A 500 V DC, min. 1 op, 'No polarity', with varistor across coil and L/R <= 1 ms) and inrush (capacitor) 140 A 20 V DC min. 70,000 ops are given. Load side has no polarity; coil is polarized. Status is not shown on the manufacturer part page; the Panasonic global EV-relay page marks the AEV*/AEVS* series (not EV-A/AEVA) 'Not Recommended for New Design'.
status: Not stated on manufacturer part page

ratings.V_rated_note: Rated switching capacity (resistive) 250 A 500 V DC
ratings.I_carry_note: Max. carrying current 250 A continuous (50 mm2 wire)

electrical_life.note: inrush resistance current (capacitor load), min.; not a break rating at bus voltage

break_max.note: switch-off life, min. 1 operation, no polarity

ratings.short_circuit_carry: 8,000 A (max. 5 ms), no smoke and no ignition
ratings.coil: 12 V DC (0.5 A, 24 ohm, 6.0 W; max 16 V DC; coil polarized)
